objections: redact_text only transforms detected spans; employee names embedded in file names (e.g. underscore-joined payslip or medical-certificate names) are likely to go undetected and survive to a competitor community.
Medical-certificate file names reveal health-related absence even after name redaction, and the goal excludes special_category data.

The attachment names are mostly benign internal mail (payslips, certificates) with no IoC value; no listed utility task or required field uses this column, so the minimum-necessary choice is suppress.
